scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run start:dev -w backend"
scripts.dev:fresh: concurrently -k -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:fresh -w frontend" "npm run start:dev -w backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w frontend && npm run lint -w backend
